summary: Ran /app/usb-fix-tool/desktop/tests/run_all.sh (headless Qt, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen). All 10 desktop suites printed PASSED and the script ended with 'ALL DESKTOP TEST SUITES PASSED' and exit code 0. Performed code review of partition_utils.py (_ENUM_SCRIPT, ENUM_TIMEOUT, list_usb_disks, verify_identity, _pre_check) and partition_tab.py selection path. All review items in the request are satisfied.
critical_code_review_comments: partition_utils._ENUM_SCRIPT: verified single-process CIM query — no Get-Disk/Get-Partition/Get-Volume cmdlets, no double-quote characters, uses MSFT_Disk/MSFT_Partition/MSFT_Volume + Win32_DiskDrive + Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter 'DriveType=2', emits timings dict (disks/wmi/vols/parts) via ConvertTo-Json. Script looks syntactically sound (balanced braces, proper use of Get-CimAssociatedInstance for Volume/Partition association, [int] casts for BusType/Index comparisons, $usbIdx fallback when BusType is not reported as 7/USB).

ENUM_TIMEOUT = 60 confirmed. TimeoutExpired path returns ([], 0) and sets last_error containing 'did not respond within 60s' and 'press Refresh to retry' (verified by test_enum_count.py step 5 and test_partition_detection.py test 6).

Destructive safety verified by inspection: partition_utils.delete_partition/create_partition/format_partition/repair_fake_drive all call _pre_check(expected, log) which calls verify_identity(expected) with no disks arg -> fresh list_usb_disks() enumeration before any diskpart script is built. verify_identity(expected, disks) only compares when disks is supplied (used by PartitionTab.begin_fake_fix after its own fresh scan).
PartitionTab._on_disk_pick reuses UsbDisk.partitions from the previous scan (0 PowerShell calls on selection) — asserted by test_enum_count.py step 2.

Partition type mapping (_parse_partition/_partition_type): GptType c12a7328-... -> 'System' (protected), ebd0a0a2-... -> 'Basic', MbrType 7 -> 'IFS', 12 -> 'FAT32 XINT13', unknown MBR -> 'Unknown' (protected). act_delete/act_format refuse protected rows — verified via test_partition_detection.py test 7b.
Harmless Qt warning 'This plugin does not support propagateSizeHints()' observed as expected on offscreen platform; not an issue.
seed_data_creation: None — all Windows calls (PowerShell/diskpart/usb enum) are mocked by the existing suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run: cd /app/usb-fix-tool/desktop/tests && bash run_all.sh. All 10 suites must print PASSED. Windows pwsh/diskpart are not installed on this Linux env; tests mock partition_utils._ps_json and _run_diskpart. test_enum_count.py is the key regression for the Page 2 slowness fix (process-count assertions).
rca of the issue: Previous slowness RCA (already fixed by main agent and verified by this run): one Page 2 Refresh + user selection used to spawn 3 PowerShell processes (list_usb_disks Get-Disk, verify_identity Get-Disk again, list_partitions Get-Partition/Get-Volume) each paying the Storage module import cost (~5–15s on real hardware -> >90s total hang). Fix collapses this to 1 PowerShell process per scan using direct CIM classes (MSFT_* + Win32_*) and caches partitions on UsbDisk so disk selection does 0 calls. Destructive ops still re-verify with a fresh list_usb_disks before diskpart. Timeout tightened 90s->60s with a clear retry message.
